g.text: Obsidian is a local-first, privacy-focused knowledge
management application built on plain Markdown files.
Using double-bracket syntax you can link to any
note, heading, or block in your vault.
Use [[Note#Heading]] to link to specific sections.
Prefix with ! to embed content inline.
A live, interactive force-directed visualization of
your entire vault as a network of connected notes.
Regions and their roles — no content
Tabs + window controls (no separate title bar on Windows)
NAV BAR — back/forward arrows, breadcrumb, right sidebar toggle, more options
Linked panes, pop-out windows, tab stacks
Pane types: note, canvas, graph, base
panels: collapse, reorder, drag between sidebars
No terminal panel, no AI panel, no MDX support, Electron (not Tauri), Markdown only (not MDX)
